Erie Strategic Ventures: Investments In Blitzy And HiddenLayer To Advance Enterprise AI Infrastructure And Security
By Amit Chowdhry
Yesterday at 4:15 PM
Erie Strategic Ventures: Investments In Blitzy And HiddenLayer To Advance Enterprise AI Infrastructure And Security
Erie Strategic Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of Erie Insurance, has announced investments in Blitzy and HiddenLayer, two technology companies focused on enterprise AI infrastructure, software modernization, and artificial intelligence security. The investments expand Erie Strategic Ventures’ portfolio of companies developing technologies that can help organizations deploy, manage, and secure AI applications.
Blitzy provides an autonomous software development platform designed to modernize large enterprise codebases through coordinated AI agents. HiddenLayer develops security technology that protects generative, predictive, and agentic AI systems throughout their lifecycles.
The investments reflect Erie Insurance’s continued exploration of AI technologies that could support its operations, independent insurance agents, and policyholders.
Erie Strategic Ventures was launched in August 2022 to invest in companies operating across the personal and commercial insurance value chain, as well as adjacent technology markets.
The venture capital program is operated with support from Cerity Partners Ventures, which helps corporations manage strategic investment initiatives.
Through the program, Erie Insurance combines capital investment with opportunities for technology collaboration and business development.
Blitzy Focuses On Autonomous Software Development
Blitzy develops an AI-powered software engineering platform intended to help enterprises modernize legacy systems and accelerate new application development.
The company’s technology uses a proprietary ontology and graph-based architecture to develop a detailed understanding of large software codebases.
This approach is designed to provide AI systems with contextual information about how applications, components, and dependencies interact.
Using that information, Blitzy coordinates thousands of AI agents operating in parallel to perform software development tasks.
The platform is intended to address challenges associated with maintaining and updating complex enterprise software environments.
Large organizations frequently operate systems that have accumulated years of modifications, integrations, and dependencies.
Modernizing these environments can require significant engineering resources because changes to one component may affect other applications or business processes.
Blitzy’s approach seeks to improve efficiency by enabling AI agents to analyze software architecture and coordinate development activities.
The company also supports the creation of new software products, allowing engineering teams to use autonomous agents for development workflows.
For insurance companies and other financial services organizations, software modernization can be particularly important because many essential business processes depend on established technology systems.
Erie Strategic Ventures’ investment provides exposure to technology intended to improve enterprise software development and infrastructure management.
